name: ecommerce-app
description: Full-stack e-commerce: Express + MongoDB API and a React storefront with an in-browser demo mode
author: Avinash Sahu

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w server -- --run && npm test -w client -- --run
